Title: Service Fabric on Windows Server and Linux VMs

Body.Content:
We’re pleased to share that we're now supporting Service Fabric on your Windows Server and Linux virtual machines (VMs) running in Azure Stack. 

This update applies primarily to Azure Stack users, but please refer to the links below for more information.

Learn more about Service Fabric on Windows Server.

Learn more about Service Fabric on Linux.

Learn more about Azure Stack roles and responsibilities.
